name: Advanced Ads
couldBuild: Ad units as a post type, placement by hook or shortcode, rotation and scheduling, and simple impression counting.
stillMissing: Placement is easy; the awkward parts are everything around it. Ad blockers, lazy loading that does not wreck viewability, consent so tags do not fire before opt-in, and the quirks of whichever network actually pays you. None of it is deep, but there is a lot of it and it changes.
requirements: Ad units with placement by hook, shortcode and content injection
Targeting by post type, device and visitor state
Consent-aware loading so tags respect the cookie banner

alternatives.name: Advanced Ads (free)
alternatives.desc: Placements, rotation and scheduling free; targeting and tracking are paid.

alternatives.desc: If one network pays you, its own tags plus a snippet plugin may be enough.
